|-----|-----------------|
| **Early Years (1970s‑80s)** | *Kenny Smith*, *Moses Malone* (brief stint), *Bill Walton* (short tenure) |
| **1990s** | *Gary Payton*, *Danny Manning*, *Julius Erving* (short stint), *Chris Webber* (trade piece) |
| **2000s** | *Pau Gasol* (first stint 2008‑2015), *Dirk Nowitzki* (trade piece), *Steve Nash* (trade piece), *Derek Fisher* (short stint) |
| **2010s** | *Paul George* (2013‑2019), *Kawhi Leonard* (2011‑2012), *DeAndre Jordan* (2010‑2017), *Jamal Crawford* (2014‑2015), *Chris Paul* (2019‑2021) |
| **Recent Years (2020‑present)** | *Lauri Markkanen* (2021‑2023), *Bam Adebayo* (2021‑present), *Reggie Jackson* (2021‑present), *Jalen Green* (2022‑present), *Coby White* (2022‑present) |
